utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll check what we’re short on and let you know first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. Just let me know what’s still needed, and I can help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I don’t have the exact details yet, but I can check and let you know. It sounds like it’ll be a helpful drive for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We still need a few volunteers for setup and tool check-in, but the big update is it’s now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not totally sure on the exact issue, but I can check and get back to you. The repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just let me know the plan and what time I should be ready to head to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street works for me. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking it—just tell me the starting spot, and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—let’s start at the community shed, and I’ll bring over a few tools to kick things off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m still tallying what we’re short on, and I’ll let you know the first priorities.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—low-key is perfect. I’ll keep the repair drive simple and fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I still need to check what’s left, but I’ll send you the details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — when and where is the repair drive? I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — I’m still waiting on the final time and place, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. We’ll be glad to have your help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—please let me know what you find. I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces, so any details would help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for keeping track. Where should we start the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in, but I don’t have the exact issue or destination details yet. Tell me when and where the repair drive is headed, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening today — same place, same time. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — what time and where should I head?
